_: AUTHORED BY HAND. What each document IS — its meaning, authority and warnings. No walk can know these. tools/sources.js merges this with a repo walk to write SOURCES.json.
_law: A source that cannot be reached is not a source. It is a thing somebody remembers.
_howToEdit: Add a path here when a document acquires meaning. Never edit SOURCES.json.

preamble._: THE SOURCE INDEX. Every document the book draws on, with a URL that can be fetched without a token. Read this first; walk from it to everything else.
preamble._why: The book is written in sessions that begin with nothing. No memory of the last one, no access to the repos, no continuity except what was written down. On 18 August a whole working night was spent with the author unable to read a single file — every fact arrived by hand, and the two occasions where reasoning ran ahead of a live reading both produced wrong answers. This file is the fix: one place that says where everything is.
preamble._law: A SOURCE THAT CANNOT BE REACHED IS NOT A SOURCE. It is a thing somebody remembers.
_howToRead: raw.githubusercontent.com is fetchable. github.com/<user>/<repo>/blob/... is NOT — it is a browse page and it is blocked.
Sizes are given because context is finite. Fetch deliberately: the Siege chronicle alone is 433 KB and will crowd out everything else.
Anything marked private:true needs a token. Do not put one in a chat. Ask the captain for the passage.
The registers are REGENERATED by the ship. Never quote a number from this file — fetch the register and read it at the hour of writing.

behindTheCaptain.what: The mirror. Six Workers, source and CONFIG.json. The mint and the proxy live here.
behindTheCaptain.note: Needed for eight of the twenty-one spells, which is why they read UNREACHABLE rather than CONFIRMED.

behindTheCaptain.what: The hub at amenti.live. Gate, fleet cards, the Glass Gate console.

branches._note: Fleet-Documents' default branch is literally named `branch`. It is not a placeholder. A URL built with `main` there returns 404, and that 404 looks exactly like a missing file.

traps: github.com/<user>/<repo>/blob/... is a browse page and is BLOCKED. Use raw.githubusercontent.com.
names.csv column zero is Rank. Find the name column BY HEADER.
A register read from this file is a memory. Fetch it.
The Siege is 433 KB and Page1 is 525 KB. Both will eat a session whole.
The hub's Engineering tab lists 8 of 41 briefs. Walk the repo, not the tab.
Several briefs appear twice under different names (quizzard / Amenti_The_Quizzard, the-leif / Amenti_The_Leif_Brief). Check both before citing.
Gameroom0.0 is a SIXTH repo and was on no list until 19 August. If a seventh exists, this index does not know about it either.
preamble._finding: THE HUB LINKS EIGHT BRIEFS. THE REPO HOLDS FORTY-ONE. The Engineering tab shows a subset and does not say so, and this index was built from that tab — so its first cut was missing thirty-three documents, including the SPEECH DOCTRINE and THE SACRED FRAMES, which are the two capabilities the captain names as the ones that make the site what it is. A list that shows part of a thing without saying which part is the same fault as a green lamp with nothing behind it.

Its opening section is not about art at all: it is the standard for HOW TO HAND WORK OVER — one idempotent script, run from the repo root, self-backing, self-verifying, guarded, non-committing, tested against a clone. Written from three failures in one session.

Amenti.live/main/CONVERSATION_DOCTRINE.m.what: THE CONVERSATION DOCTRINE. The governing logic for two-way voice and text conversation between a seeker and a figure — the spec the chat core's state machine and system prompt are built from. Deliberately a doctrine and not a feature list, so every mount (Terminal, reading vault, Atlantica, news article) inherits one coherent character instead of four drifting ones. Its one line above all others: patient with humans, stingy with waste, never hang up on someone who is present or hurting. Extended 27 Aug 2026 with §4.6, WHAT THE FIGURE REMEMBERS: the figure never asks for more than a name, but may remember what it was told. Holds the coarseness rule that makes memory safe — a region never a town, a kind of work never an employer, no age and no surname, because many users are young — and the rule that recognition is in the answering, not in a recital.
Amenti.live/main/CONVERSATION_DOCTRINE.m.authority: canonical, and LIVE — this is a governing document, not an account of a day. If it and amenti-chat.js disagree, that is a finding.

Amenti.live/main/PIPELINE.md.what: ADDING A FIGURE — the whole pipeline in five steps. The proprietor writes the prompt, generates in OpenArt at 9:16 2K and keeps the SEED, sends the file for audit, runs one ingest.py command, commits. The script crops, resizes, measures saturation, computes the grade factor, stamps provenance into the JPEG and the manifest and rewrites img/grades.css. Page1.html is NEVER edited to add a figure.
Amenti.live/main/PIPELINE.md.authority: canonical operating procedure. Names what still needs a person: the judgement on whether a plate holds, and the seed — four seconds at generation, unrecoverable afterwards.

Its counts are none — it holds no numbers, only intent; the firing log holds what fired.

Amenti.live/main/fleet-status.html.what: THE CAPTAIN'S WINDOW ON THE FLEET. Reads fleet.json (intent) and fleet-dispatch.json (reality) live and lays them side by side: for each tube, what it is meant to do against what it actually fired. State-aware — a paused tube reading quiet is calm; a live tube that has never fired shows red. The map of the presses, self-reading, so the fleet can be read at a glance instead of interrogated.
Amenti.live/main/fleet-status.html.authority: canonical surface. Reads two registers and renders them; it stores nothing and decides nothing. If it disagrees with the registers, the registers are right and this has a display bug.

Amenti-Technical-Briefs/main/BRIEF-WHAT-.section: the briefs — 41 files, 8 of them linked anywhere
Amenti-Technical-Briefs/main/BRIEF-WHAT-.what: WHAT AN HOUR COSTS, 27 Aug 2026. A reading, not an estimate: the prompt was built and measured. $1.24 an hour typing, $2.48 talking, text only. The system prompt is 57% of the input and is re-sent every turn; the anchored window is what makes any of it priceable. Notes that DAILY_TOKENS 2,000,000 means about five conversations a day, not five hundred, and that prompt caching is the largest untouched saving. The CHARTED edition is the one to read; this holds the fuller argument and the method.
Amenti-Technical-Briefs/main/BRIEF-WHAT-.authority: canonical, and MEASURED. Prices are Sonnet 4.6 and Haiku 4.5 list at the date of writing and will drift; the method is in the brief so it can be re-run rather than believed.

Amenti-Technical-Briefs/main/Amenti_What.section: the briefs — 41 files, 8 of them linked anywhere
Amenti-Technical-Briefs/main/Amenti_What.what: WHAT AN HOUR COSTS, charted. Four drawings, each making one claim: the system prompt is 55% of every turn and is re-sent; the anchored window is what makes any of it priceable; the daily breaker allows 48 ten-turn visits, not five and not five hundred; and prompt caching is the only lever that takes nothing away. $1.24 an hour typing, $2.48 talking.
Amenti-Technical-Briefs/main/Amenti_What.authority: canonical, and MEASURED. Every figure comes from one FACTS block and the charts draw from it — the prose names no number of its own. Prices are Sonnet 4.6 and Haiku 4.5 list at the date of writing and will drift; one figure, the caching saving, is an ASSUMPTION and is marked with an asterisk on its own chart.

Amenti-Technical-Briefs/main/BRIEF-THE-P.section: the briefs — 41 files, 8 of them linked anywhere
Amenti-Technical-Briefs/main/BRIEF-THE-P.what: THE PROMPT NOBODY CACHES, 27 Aug 2026. The 2,244-token system prompt is byte-identical every turn and re-sent every time. Caching saves 22% as the prompt stands and 33% if the reader's name and recollection move to the tail — the cacheable prefix goes 56% to 85%. The cache is PER FIGURE, not per conversation, so it compounds with concurrency. The only lever that removes nothing.
Amenti-Technical-Briefs/main/BRIEF-THE-P.authority: canonical spec, and MEASURED — the same prompt was built for two readers and the strings compared. Cache pricing is Anthropic's published 1.25× write and 0.1× read. §6 names the one real design decision (where the client and proxy agree the seam is) and §9 what is still unknown.
